<div class="card-body">
'''WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ＷＥＤ－９－Ｍ１ “バンサ” ドロイド</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">同じ位置カードにいるすべてのビークルとドロイドは、耐：損耗＜２。“バンサ”ドロイドがドッキング・ベイにいれば、同じ星系カードにいるすべての宇宙戦闘機は、耐：損耗＜３。「予期せぬ損傷」のカードをキャンセルできる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-32o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジャワがパーツを寄せ集めて作った、地上にただ一台のトレッドウェル・ドロイド。今はドッキング・ベイ９４の管理者、デマルズが所有している。鈍重で頑固な性格から、“バンサ”と呼ばれている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' WED-9-M1 “Bantha” Droid.

'''Card text:''' All vehicles and droids at the same site are immune to attrition less than 2. If Bantha Droid is at a docking bay, all starfighters at the same system are immune to attrition less than 3. May cancel Unexpected Damage.

'''Lore:''' A one-of-a-kind Treadwell droid assembled from parts by Jawas. It now belongs to Demalz, the overseer of Docking Bay 94. Its sluggish, stubborn nature earned it the name Bantha.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[WED-9-M1 'Bantha' Droid]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
